Make It Wearable 
Intel launched the global Make It Wearable challenge  
in early 2014 to fuel innovation in wearable technology. 
Featuring expert mentorship, business development, and

$1.3 million in cash prizes, the year-long challenge aims 
to inspire, identify, and incubate wearable technology ideas with the potential to 
shift universal perspective and improve the world in meaningful ways. Challenges 
such as Make It Wearable help spur young people to become entrepreneurs and 
inventors. Watch the video.
